title: Matte White Toilet Paper Stand, 29-Inch Freestanding Euro Style Toilet Tissue Holder - Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when wall space is tight—without drilling into tile in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. This freestanding toilet paper stand delivers a stable, traditional look with solid brass construction and a heavy base to help prevent tipping.

  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • European-style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy
  • Heavy base helps keep the stand secure from tipping
  • Traditional styling pairs well with classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware
  • Backed by a limited lifetime warranty

Specs

  • Overall dimensions: 8 in L x 27 in H x 6 in W
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Freestanding (no wall mounting)
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Included: Toilet tissue stand
  • Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection for a cohesive, matching Carolina look.
